_comment: Events that aren't in the FTC Events system (e.g. unofficial scrimmages), with results read off their livestream's results and rankings screens. build_season_pages.py converts each one to FTC API-format JSON and runs FtcStats.cs on it. Match 'red'/'blue' list teams by station; 'score' is [red, blue] final score; 'foul' is [red, blue] foul points committed (awarded to the other alliance); 'bonus' lists the bonus RP flags each alliance earned; 'surrogate' lists teams whose appearance doesn't count, 'noShow' teams that weren't on the field, and 'dq' teams that were disqualified. 'auto' is [red, blue] auto points, read from the score overlay at the start of teleop (it includes leave and park). 't' is the match start in the video, in seconds.

BRGOAMI1.name: Amistoso FTC - Planalto
notes: An unofficial friendly hosted by SESI Planalto, so it isn't on FTC Events. Results were read from the results and rankings screens shown on the [JUSTICE FTC livestream](https://www.youtube.com/live/mDmLDCKXviQ), and auto points from the score overlay at the start of teleop.

Qualification 5 had two surrogates (23276 and 31146). 38388 (Blue Gear, from Brasília) was still on the road for Qualifications 2–4 and arrived after Qualification 6, so those three are no-shows: no ranking or tiebreak points, and left out of OPR.
